providers.name: 澳門特別行政區政府入口網站

authorization.scope: One explicitly selected locally known labour-department public news URL for private diagnosis. Preserve exact government-owned text, release department, source clock and capture date; exclude third-party or specially restricted works and all media. No publication, public deep-linking, automatic training export, endpoint guessing or numeric-ID enumeration.
authorization.rights_restrictions: Official portal terms allow noncommercial unmodified copying with source/capture-date attribution, not a commercial or third-party license. Non-homepage linking by external websites requires separate authorization; no public article links or body export. Terms/refusals/robots stay authoritative.

providers.note: Bounded diagnosis uses a separate private state root because the canonical live owner has no source for this host. No shared-host overlap or queue writes. The native adapter verifies one current article against canonical/og/schema/visible headline, the reviewed labour-department credit and its own naive release datetime. Preserve visible captions and financial/employment values, exclude gallery controls/media, never infer a timezone from the schema offset alone; exact raw schema retained. Source diagnosis alone is not durable article coverage.
